def: to be impure in a religious sense

words.word: neither shall ye make yourselves unclean

occurrences.text: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
words: neither shall ye make yourselves unclean

occurrences.text: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?
